scenarios.title: The polished demo proves too much
scenarios.prompt: A vendor presents a fluent AI assistant in a polished demo. The team begins describing the product as reliable and intelligent, although the critical workflow was not tested with company data.
scenarios.question: What should the team require next?

options.text: A scripted test against predefined capabilities, failure cases and company data.
A longer presentation so the team can judge the product’s personality.
A list of well-known customers as a substitute for task testing.

scenarios.explanation: Humanlike presentation can inflate perceived capability. Predefined criteria force the product to demonstrate the task that matters in the real environment.
missingEvidence: Evidence under the organisation’s data and controls.
scenarios.evidenceNote: Anthropomorphism is a relevant lens for capability inference from presentation. The demo may still represent real capability, which must be tested directly.
scenarios.nextAction: Run the same evidence-based acceptance test for every serious vendor.

scenarios.title: The first price defines the negotiation
scenarios.prompt: A vendor opens with a three-year price of €900,000. Internal discussions now focus on whether a 15% discount is enough, although the team never estimated value or alternatives independently.
scenarios.question: What should be created before the next commercial round?

options.text: An independent value range, reservation point and comparison with alternatives.
A more detailed explanation of why €900,000 is the vendor’s normal price.
A discount target expressed only as a percentage of the opening price.

scenarios.explanation: The opening number defines the frame. An independent estimate gives the team a separate basis for price and scope decisions.
missingEvidence: Expected value and total cost of ownership.
A reservation point defined before the next offer.
scenarios.evidenceNote: Anchoring is plausible because all later numbers are expressed around the opening price. The opening price can still be reasonable if independent evidence supports it.
scenarios.nextAction: Write an independent commercial range and the assumptions behind it.
